findings.area: Top 14 — the Sunday fixture falls after the French DST change
findings.detail: La Rochelle v Bordeaux-Bègles is listed at 21h05 on Sunday 25 October. France leaves CEST at 03:00 that morning, so 21h05 is CET and equals 20:05Z; a naive CEST conversion would have produced 19:05Z and looked like an error in the row.
findings.status: Confirmed, no change. Recorded because the same trap applies to every Sunday European fixture after 25 October.
findings.source_name: LNR Top 14 official calendar, journée 7
